name: Schnitt 5.19.0
notes:
# Schnitt 5.19.0

Schnitt 5.19.0 makes multi-selection faster, brings updates and imports into the app, and rebuilds Image to XML around a cleaner tracer. It also hardens graphics startup after a native crash.

## Paste across a selection

Paste Layer and Paste Style now work on several selected layers at once, on phones and in the desktop multi-selection panel. Clipboard actions keep the selection order and apply each paste to every chosen layer, so a whole group can be styled in one step.

## Updates inside the app

The update sheet lets you choose the APK that matches your device. Schnitt downloads it in the app with a progress bar, verifies the release signature and checksum, and changes the button to **Install**. The system installer opens with the downloaded file, and a successful install removes the temporary APK.

The update list prefers the right architecture for the phone and does not offer an Android 13-only build to a compatible install by default.

## Import with progress

Project imports show a progress bar with an estimated time. Linked imports report download and processing separately, so a large package no longer looks frozen. A normal project opens as soon as the import finishes.

## Image to XML rebuilt

The bitmap tracer now uses weighted palette selection, small-region cleanup, marching-squares contours, and adaptive simplification. A solid background is added only when the image is fully opaque, so transparent artwork keeps its holes.

Traces are cleaner and smaller across 10 to 64 colours, with rectangle and ellipse snapping and cubic curves only where they stay faithful to the source. The generated SVG opens directly as an editable project.

## Graphics stability

The engine remembers which graphics backend was in use if the app closed natively while editing, and starts the other backend next time instead of retrying the crashing one. HONOR phones on Android 17 start with OpenGL, avoiding a Vulkan driver crash seen on that combination. The Vulkan swapchain path also rejects unusable images instead of dereferencing a missing surface.

## Downloads

| File | Phones | Android |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app-arm64-v8a.apk` | 64-bit ARM | 13 and newer |
| `app-armeabi-v7a.apk` | 32-bit ARM | 13 and newer |
| `app-universal.apk` | ARM64, ARM32 and x86_64 | 13 and newer |
| `app-compatible-arm64-v8a.apk` | 64-bit ARM | 7.0 and newer |
| `app-compatible-armeabi-v7a.apk` | 32-bit ARM | 7.0 and newer |

Install the standard APK whenever Android 13 or newer is available. The compatible APKs have the same features and use the API-24 engine and safe fallbacks older phones need.

## Fixes

- Removed two unsafe non-null assertions in the update flow that could fail on a malformed release response.
- The release signer fingerprint used by update checks matches the published APKs.
- Effect migration keeps unknown imported effects and their values instead of replacing them with a guess.
- The bitmap tracer never adds an opaque background to an image that contains transparency.
